source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'two new members were returned unopposed' and the other two wards had no other nominations

note: Annual election of Larne Urban Council, poll 16 January 1933. Five wards each returned one member. Four were returned unopposed — John Kirkwood (Central), J. H. Lord (Curran), Captain Andrew Ferris (Townparks) and J. W. Sandford (Gardenmore; given as M.P.S.) — and only Inver Ward was contested, between Miss S. E. Morrow, daughter of a sitting member, and Mr. T. Shannon, the retiring member (Belfast News-Letter, 3 January 1933, p. 11). The Inver result has not been found in the Larne Times (21 and 28 January 1933), the Belfast News-Letter (17-20 January 1933) or the Belfast Telegraph files read, so the round is partial: four of the five seats are recorded and the fifth is named only by its candidates. Returned unopposed.
